newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Q1 GDP rises 1.6 from Q1 1996.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Q1 GDP rises 1.6 from Q1 1996.

text.p: Swedish Gross Domestic Product rose 1.6 percent in the first quarter of 1997 compared with the first quarter of 1996, Statistics Sweden said on Wednesday.
Compared with the previous quarter, GDP slipped 0.3 percent.
Statistics Sweden said exports and private consumption expenditure made positive contributions to the growth of GDP in the first quarter of 1997.
Exports of goods and services rose by seven percent while the increase of imports was 4.8 percent.
Private consumption expenditure increased by 0.9 percent.
Negative contributions were made by gross fixed capital formation, government consumption expenditure and changes in stocks.

Total gross fixed capital formation fell by 5.7 percent. Government consumption expenditure declined by 3.3 percent. Production in industrires rose by 2.7 percent while production by government dropped 2.8 percent.
SWEDISH GROSS DOMESTIC PRODUCT (pct change yr/yr)
NOTE - Swedish GDP was expected to rise 1.6 percent in the first quarter of 1997, a Reuters poll showed.
